svg.title: GitHub Actions hosted runner incident, October 5, 2026: timeline and impact
svg.desc: Top: timeline in UTC from GitHub's status page. Impact started at 18:48, GitHub posted the first status update at 19:11, mitigations were applied at 21:32, Actions was operating normally at 21:54, and all services recovered at 22:49. Bottom: impact figures from GitHub's incident summary. Over the full incident, 14.3 percent of workflow runs on GitHub-hosted runners and 26.5 percent of GitHub-hosted jobs did not start within five minutes. During the roughly 90-minute peak, 47.0 percent of workflow runs on GitHub-hosted runners failed and 71.9 percent of GitHub-hosted jobs did not start within five minutes. Self-hosted runners were not affected.
